perturbed_solution: If Sally makes $55\%$ of her 20 shots, she makes $0.55 \times 20 = 12$ shots. If Sally makes $56\%$ of her 25 shots, she makes $0.56 \times 25 = 13$ shots. So she makes $13-12=\boxed{1}$ of the last 5 shots.

errors.rationale: The calculation $0.55 \times 20 = 11$ is correct, but it has been changed to 12. This is an arithmetic error that cascades through the solution.
The calculation $0.56 \times 25 = 14$ is correct, but it has been changed to 13. This is an arithmetic error in computing the total shots made after 25 attempts.

The subtraction is now performed with the incorrect intermediate values (13 and 12 instead of 14 and 11), yielding 1 instead of the correct answer 3. This represents misuse of the values derived from earlier arithmetic errors.
